question: Which of the following is Hinduism's major philosophical school ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vaisheshika**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vaisheshika** is one of the **six orthodox schools of Hindu philosophy** (Astika).
 
• It was founded by the sage **Kanada** and is known for its naturalism.
